state.seed_assertion: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.

sentences.1: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.2: The fact that the DPIA may need to be updated once the processing has actually started is not a valid reason for postponing or not carrying out a DPIA.
sentences.3: Records of processing operations should include relevant risk information including reasons why a DPIA needs to be carried out, or not.
sentences.4: Records of processing operations should include relevant risk information including reasons why a DPIA needs to be carried out, or not.
sentences.5: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar when relying on a previously completed substantially similar DPIA.
sentences.6: You need to be confident that you can demonstrate that the nature, scope, context and purposes of the processing are all similar.
sentences.7: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.8: The mere fact that the conditions triggering the obligation to carry out DPIA have not been met does not, however, diminish controllers' general obligation to implement measures to appropriately manage risks for the rights and freedoms of data subjects.
sentences.9: The ICO will generally respond within eight weeks once it has the information needed, or it can extend this by a further six weeks in complex cases.
sentences.10: Once we have the information we need, we will generally respond within eight weeks (although we can extend this by a further six weeks in complex cases).
sentences.11: This means that although you have not yet assessed the actual level of risk, you need to screen for factors that point to the potential for a widespread or serious impact on individuals.
sentences.12: One should explain in the DPIA why a DPIA was needed, detailing the types of intended processing that made it a requirement.
